name: hit-the-ground-running
description: Hit The Ground Running: pushes the plan's 5-hour and weekly usage to the model, closes the agent-pool gate (no new subagents) near a limit but not on usage credits (switchable off per session, or suspended until the 5-hour reset with /htgr-gate, and suspended automatically when usage runs out), pauses running sessions at 90% of the 5-hour limit, and resumes the session after a cap resets, compacting first when the context is large, re-injects your ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (imports expanded) at every session start, clear, compaction and resume, and with workflowDir set adds that agent workflow's root instructions.

fiveHourResume.title: 5-hour cap resume
fiveHourResume.description: native: Claude's own auto-continue resumes 5-hour caps and the mod only compacts before it. mod: the mod resumes 5-hour caps itself; turn the native auto-continue off to avoid a double resume.

autoPause.title: Auto-pause at 5-hour usage
autoPause.description: When the 5-hour usage reaches this percentage, each session with a running turn does what /htgr-pause does: stops the turn and resumes after the 5-hour reset. Once per session per 5-hour period; off disables it.

weeklyResume.title: Weekly cap resume
weeklyResume.description: on: the mod resumes the session after a weekly cap resets. off: it does not.

workflowDir.title: Workflow directory
workflowDir.description: Absolute path of an Agent-Custom-Workflow checkout. When set, the loader also hands the model its workflows/AGENTS.root.md (and its CLAUDE.md, when your ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md does not import it) and tells it to read its intake owners and the personality on the 'Personality:' line before acting. Empty: off.

userInstructions.title: Re-inject your CLAUDE.md
userInstructions.description: on: every session start, clear, compaction, resume or fork hands the model your ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md with its @ imports expanded, so your own instructions hold for the whole session, workflow or not. off: it does not.
